M07 stop settlement after closure.Source: SVB-53 (D4) ADR-100 flag, default off (off = logs byte-identical to bc4c1c2). On: M07 publishes no PaymentSettled after this bank's BankClosed and freezes its queues. Reason: once a regulator closes a bank, payments stop until a receiver or bridge bank reopens (SVB closed Fri Mar 10 2023; the FDIC bridge bank opened Mon Mar 13). Can move settled numbers after a closure, so it stays off for calibration.
